title: Runewake Tutorial Script
description: Schema for tutorial script data: consequence-first tutorial beats with deterministic opponent turns. Each beat = player acts → see consequence → one-line rule popup. Maximum ONE popup per action.

description.description: Optional short description of what the tutorial covers.

items.description: Artifact definition ID for one of this class's slots.

artifacts.description: Artifact def IDs for the player's class loadout, in slot order.

player_deck.description: Full deck list for the player (card def IDs, in shuffle order). The deck is dealt deterministically (no shuffle) so the starting hand is known.

opponent_deck.description: Full deck list for the opponent. Not shuffled — deterministic order.

turns.description: Scripts for each turn. Opponent turns are fully deterministic. Player turns contain conditional beats that resolve based on the player's action.

player_hand_override.description: If set, override the player's hand to these exact card def IDs (in order). Used to guarantee the player has the right cards for the tutorial beat.

opponent_hand_override.description: If set, override the opponent's hand to these exact card def IDs.

player_attunement_override.description: If set, override the player's attunement for this turn.

player_beats.description: Sequential beats the player must complete this turn. Beats resolve in order; each must be satisfied before the next activates. At most one popup fires per beat.

opponent_actions.description: Deterministic scripted actions for the opponent's turn. These execute in order with no player input.

id.description: Unique beat identifier within this tutorial (e.g. 't1_summon', 't2_hold_back').

trigger_event.description: The player action that triggers this beat's response.

condition.description: Optional additional constraints on when this beat activates (e.g. must not attack).

popup.description: The one-line popup text shown after the player acts. Explains the consequence and the rule. Max ONE popup per beat.

highlight.description: UI elements to highlight before the player acts (guides attention).

restrict_actions_to.description: If set, restricts the player's valid actions to only these types during this beat. Used to force the teaching moment.

trigger_event.description: The event that triggers this beat's popup. 'ANY' = fires the first time the player does anything valid after the previous beat.

not_attacked_this_turn.description: If true, this beat only activates if the player has not attacked this turn.

attacked_count_gte.description: This beat only activates if the player has attacked at least this many times this turn.

creatures_summoned_gte.description: This beat only activates if at least this many creatures have been summoned this turn.

action.description: The action the opponent takes deterministically.

card_id.description: Card def ID to summon or play. Required for SUMMON and PLAY_SPELL.

lane.description: Lane index for SUMMON or ATTACK target.

target_lane.description: Lane index of the ATTACK target.

label.description: Optional commentary shown to the player while the opponent acts (e.g. 'Your opponent summons a creature.').

delay_ms.description: Delay before this action executes (for visual pacing).
